doshas.name: Mangal (Kuja) Dosha
doshas.note: Mars sits in your 6th house — not a Manglik house from the Lagna. There is only a mild Mangal influence measured from the Moon. This is easily pacified and should not worry you for marriage; a simple Mangal-shanti before the wedding is enough.

doshas.name: Kaal Sarp Yoga
doshas.note: Not present in full — Jupiter and Saturn fall outside the Rahu–Ketu axis, so the yoga does not form here.

doshas.name: Sade Sati
doshas.note: You are not in Sade Sati at present — Saturn is transiting the 9th from your natal Moon, not over it. These are peaceful years for the mind.

coreNature: Beta, your Lagna is Meena (Pisces) rising in Revati nakshatra — the gentlest, most compassionate of all rising signs, ruled by Guru (Jupiter), the great teacher. This gives you a soft, wise, devotional heart, imagination, and a natural pull toward faith and helping others. Revati Lagna souls are often the quiet guides that others lean upon.

What makes your chart special is that Guru, your Lagna lord, sits in the 9th house of Vrischika (Scorpio) — the house of bhagya (fortune, dharma, father, higher learning). This is a blessed placement: your destiny is protected by grace, and you rise through honesty, faith and the blessings of elders and gurus. Guru is retrograde (vakri), which turns his wisdom inward — you learn deeply from experience and mature into a source of counsel for your family.

Shani (Saturn) sits in your Lagna itself, in Meena. This gives you seriousness, patience, endurance and an old-soul maturity beyond your years — but it also tends to make the big milestones of life (marriage, property, settling down) arrive after a period of patient effort rather than very early. This is not a flaw; it is Shani teaching you to build things that last.

Chandra (Moon) is beautifully placed in her own sign Karka (Cancer) in the 5th house of santaan (children), creativity and love. A strong, dignified Moon in the 5th is one of the finest indications for emotional depth, a loving nature, and — importantly for your questions — healthy prospects of progeny.

houseHighlights.title: 2nd (wealth, family, speech) – Ketu in Mesha
houseHighlights.text: a spiritual detachment toward money; you earn but are not greedy. Watch measured speech.

houseHighlights.title: 3rd (courage, communication) – Mercury in Vrishabha
houseHighlights.text: a steady, practical mind and good communication and skills; you can build through effort and networks.

houseHighlights.title: 4th (home, mother, property, comforts) – Sun & Venus in Mithuna
houseHighlights.text: a strong desire for a beautiful home and vehicles; property and domestic comfort are important life themes (directly relevant to your house-buying question).

houseHighlights.title: 5th (children, romance, intellect) – Moon in own Karka
houseHighlights.text: excellent for love, creativity and children.

houseHighlights.title: 6th (effort, health, competition) – Mars in Simha
houseHighlights.text: a fighter's energy that helps you overcome enemies and obstacles; good for discipline, though guard against stress.

houseHighlights.title: 8th (transformation) – Rahu in Tula
houseHighlights.text: sudden turns and deep interests; be careful in speculation and shortcuts.

houseHighlights.title: 9th (fortune, dharma) – Jupiter (lagna lord)
houseHighlights.text: your greatest strength — fortune, faith and the protection of gurus and elders.

answers.question: When will I get married?
answers.answer:
Marriage is read from the 7th house (Kanya / Virgo), its lord Budh (Mercury), and the great karaka of marriage, Shukra (Venus). Here is the beautiful part: you are running the Shukra (Venus) Mahadasha (2014–2034) — the very period that most naturally ripens marriage, and Venus in your chart sits in the 4th house of home and domestic happiness.

Right now you are in Venus–Jupiter (Oct 2024 – Jun 2027). Jupiter is your Lagna lord and a supreme benefic — a Venus–Guru sub-period is one of the classic marriage-making windows in Vedic astrology. Because Shani sits in your Lagna (which gently delays but strengthens), the most likely window is from the latter half of 2025 through 2027, with a strong secondary window as you enter Venus–Saturn (mid-2027 onwards) when Saturn finally "settles" what he has been maturing. In short, marriage is near and well-supported — most probably between late 2025 and 2027. A serious, lasting match (Saturn's signature) is indicated rather than a hasty one.

answers.question: When will we have a child?
answers.answer:
Children are read from the 5th house (Karka / Cancer), its lord Chandra (Moon), and the karaka of progeny, Guru (Jupiter). Your chart is genuinely blessed here: the Moon sits in her own sign in the 5th house itself — a textbook indication of healthy santaan (progeny) — and Jupiter, the giver of children, is strong in the 9th aspecting your fortune.

Since childbirth naturally follows marriage, the timing flows from the same dasha. After marriage in the 2025–2027 window, the Venus–Saturn period (mid-2027 to 2030) and the Jupiter sub-periods within it are most promising for the first child — most likely around 2028–2029. With the Moon so well placed, I foresee joy in this area of life; do the Santaan Gopal remedies below when you begin planning, and the blessing will come.

answers.question: Should I buy a house this year?
answers.answer:
Property and home are the domain of the 4th house (Mithuna / Gemini), where you have both Surya (Sun) and Shukra (Venus). Venus in the 4th, and Venus being your running Mahadasha lord, is a supportive signature for acquiring property, comforts and vehicles during this very period. So the underlying current is favourable.

My guidance, beta: yes, this year is auspicious to move toward buying a home — but do it with a proper muhurat (auspicious timing) for the registry and griha pravesh (house-warming). Prefer a Thursday or Friday in a Shukla Paksha (waxing moon), and avoid finalising when Mercury or Venus are retrograde or during the Chaturmas shraddha fortnight. Since Shani is in your Lagna, do not over-stretch your loan — buy within comfortable means and it will bless you for years. If you wish, WhatsApp me your shortlisted dates and I will personally pick the strongest muhurat for you.

remedies.title: Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj)
remedies.text: to strengthen Guru, your Lagna lord and giver of children and wisdom. Set in gold, worn on the index finger of the right hand, first on a Thursday morning after energising with the Guru mantra. This is your primary, life-supporting gemstone.

remedies.title: Opal or White Sapphire
remedies.text: to support Shukra (Venus), your marriage karaka and Mahadasha lord, aiding marriage, harmony and property. Set in silver or white gold, worn on the middle/ring finger, first on a Friday. (Please have it checked for suitability before wearing.)

remedies.title: Mantra for marriage & wisdom
remedies.text: chant “Om Gram Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah” 108 times on Thursdays, and “Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah” on Fridays.

remedies.title: For children (when planning)
remedies.text: recite the Santaan Gopal mantra and offer worship to Lord Krishna; feed and bless young children.

remedies.title: For Shani in Lagna
remedies.text: light a mustard-oil lamp and read the Hanuman Chalisa on Saturdays; donate black sesame or mustard oil — this softens delays and steadies your path.

remedies.title: Mild Mangal
remedies.text: worship Hanuman ji on Tuesdays and offer red masoor daal (lentils) before the wedding.

interpretation.closingBlessing: May Guru's grace and Ma Lakshmi's blessings be upon you, beta. A good marriage, healthy children and a happy home are all written kindly in your stars — walk toward them with faith and honest effort.
